name: Szakadát (Hungary)
description: Pale blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szakadát: a quartered red, white and green shield with a church, a bough, a ploughshare and ears of grain, with yellow mantling, above a yellow scroll inscribed Szakadát.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szakadát arms with mantling and scroll
